subject: Scheduling Thursday's lab equipment delivery
text: Hi there, since our class priorities shifted after the project deadline moved, I wanted to ask whether we can reschedule the equipment delivery. I can be available between two and four on Thursday, or I can help collect the materials earlier if that suits the lab schedule. Please let me know which option works for your teammates, and I will update the group so the boxes are not left unattended. I hope the new timing does not inconvenience anyone, and I am happy to adjust again if needed.
